queries: WITH rental_totals AS (SELECT r.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS payment_total FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id LEFT JOIN payment AS p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(payment_total) AS avg_payment_total FROM rental_totals) SELECT rt.store_id, SUM(rt.payment_total) AS payment_total, AVG(rt.payment_total - o.avg_payment_total) AS avg_excess FROM rental_totals AS rt CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE rt.payment_total > o.avg_payment_total GROUP BY rt.store_id ORDER BY rt.store_id;
